newsitem.title: USA: Home Savings Bank/Siler City full results.
newsitem.headline: Home Savings Bank/Siler City full results.

text.p: Home Savings Bank of Siler City Inc, Siler City, North Carolina reported earnings for the quarter ended December 31, 1996 of $149,421.00. This compares favorably to the $139,000.00 reported for the same period last year.
On a per share basis, net income was $.16 per share for the quarter. The Bank has 922,686 shares of common stock outstanding as of December 31, 1996.
At its Board of Director's meeting today, the Board of Directors declared a semi-annual cash dividend of $.20 per share to shareholders of record on February 21, 1997 and payable on March 7, 1997.
At December 31, 1996, total assets were $52.82 million, net loans were $30.16 million and total deposits were $42.08 million.
